tbl_description: One row per pooled regional sample: a (cruise x region) composite. Venrick CalCOFI phytoplankton are pooled across stations into 4 regions (NE/SE/Alley/Offshore; Hayward & Venrick 1998) before counting, so there is no per-station position. latitude/longitude are a representative point of the region polygon, derived from the station membership the source declares and guaranteed to fall inside that region (see `region`, and questions Q01).

Phytoplankton abundance in long form: one row per (sample, taxon). measurement_type = phytoplankton_abundance, measurement_value = cells/L (provisional units, Q02). Group-SUM rows from the source are derivable from taxa and excluded (Q03).
Taxon lookup keyed by the source species_code (Venrick code), with verbatim taxa group + species and a best-effort WoRMS aphia_id (partial; phytoplankton are poorly covered, Q05).

The 4 pooled regions defined on the CalCOFI grid (Hayward & Venrick 1998), with the member station codes the source declares and a POLYGON derived from them: each declared station claims the water nearest to it, clipped to the convex hull of all 34 stations and dissolved by region, so the four tile their pooled domain with no overlap and no gaps. Stations are placed by the `+proj=calcofi` transform rather than a grid lookup, which is what lets the six intermediate inshore stations with no cell in the regularized grid resolve. latitude/longitude is an interior representative point, not a centroid (the regions are concave). Land is not erased. See questions Q01.
